answer_1.quote: We explore Practical In-Image Multilingual Machine Translation (IIMMT)... we annotate a dataset PRIM... The main contributions... propose a novel model VisTrans, the first end-to-end model designed for practical conditions. By handling the visual text and background information of the images separately, our model is able to generate multilingual target images with integrity backgrounds.
answer_1.outputs: target images containing translated text in the visual modality

answer_2.quote: We use EasyOCR ... to recognize the generated images ... calculate BLEU and COMET to assess the translation quality ... To evaluate the visual effect of the output images automatically and objectively, we calculate the Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) between the generated images and the reference images.
